description: List Japanese government tender notices published by a named buyer — a ministry, agency, prefecture or city — matched on partial organisation name (e.g. "国土交通省", "防衛省", "横浜市"). Sourced from the 官公需情報ポータルサイト (Kankoju public procurement portal, Japan SME Agency). Optionally narrowed by category, keyword and announcement date range.

category.description: One of goods | works | services (or 物品 | 工事 | 役務, or 1 | 2 | 3).

full_text.description: Return the full announcement text instead of a preview. Default false.

organization_name.description: Buyer organisation, partial match, in Japanese — e.g. "国土交通省" (MLIT), "経済産業省" (METI), "札幌市".

query.description: Optional keyword to narrow within the organisation.

name: japan_tenders_by_organization
title: Japan Tenders By Organization
